description:
A saved reply named 'Password Reset Instructions' exists in the 'IT Support' mailbox. This saved reply contains outdated information referencing the old IT portal at legacy.internal.corp/reset. The company has migrated to a new SSO platform, and this saved reply needs to be updated.

Your task:
1. Log in to FreeScout at http://localhost:8080 as admin@helpdesk.local (password: Admin123!) if not already logged in.
2. Navigate to the Saved Replies management area.
3. Find the saved reply named 'Password Reset Instructions'.
4. Edit it as follows:
   - Change the name to: SSO Password Reset Guide
   - Replace the entire body with:

Hello,

To reset your password on our new SSO platform, please follow these steps:

1. Go to https://sso.company.com/reset
2. Enter your corporate email address
3. Click "Send Reset Link"
4. Check your inbox for the reset email (check spam/junk if not found within 5 minutes)
5. Follow the link and create a new password that meets the complexity requirements

Your new password must be at least 12 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character.

If you continue to experience issues, please reply to this email and we will assist you further.

Best regards,
IT Support Team

5. Save the changes.

IMPORTANT: You must EDIT the existing saved reply, not create a new one.
